editor.addDescription: Start with your payment provider: connecting it with a read-only key verifies your MRR. If yours is not in the list, choose Other. Product details are public.
editor.limit: You have listed {limit} products, which is the most an account can have. Delete a product to add another.
editor.editDescription: Product details and verified figures are public. You can hide the figures.
editor.requiredDescription: Connect a supported payment provider with read-only access. New products are listed only after a successful connection. You can hide the verified figures.
editor.pendingConnection: Your product is saved privately. Connect a supported payment provider to publish it.

chooseProvider: Choose your payment provider. If it is not in the list, choose Other.

figures.title: Public figures
figures.description: Verified figures are public unless you hide them. Public revenue is ranked on the leaderboard, by MRR and by revenue over 30 days, 12 months and all time.

details.title: Product
details.description: Shown on the public product page and in listings. Fields marked * are required.
details.name: Product name
details.taglinePlaceholder: What does it help people do?
details.descriptionPlaceholder: Who it is for, what it does, and what makes it different.

tech.title: Tech stack
tech.description: What the product is built with, up to {max}. Shown on its page, with links to other products built with the same.

badge.title: Badge for your website
badge.description: Shows your verified MRR on your own site and links to your product page. It shows the figure only while you share it; otherwise it says Listed on {site}.
